name: Thilo Koch
headline: Head of Product Mgmt @Maltego
summary:
• I am fascinated by experiences—products & services—that solve real-life problems. I made it my personal goal to do the same for companies like Maltego (market-leading link analysis for fighting crime & cybersecurity), Freeletics (exceptional sports & fitness app) and GEIST/Memorado (one of Germany's leading mental fitness apps).

• Working as a Head of Product/PM in high growth environments has taught me the necessary skills to solve people's problems with software—enabling interdisciplinary teams of developers, designers, content creators and data analysts in the process.

• During my studies I made it a mission to learn about the world. I did so by using the great educational systems which I was lucky to have access to. I'm drawing from those experiences each and every day. I'm a strong believer in diversity, equality/equity and inclusion.

company.name: Maltego
company.tagline: Maltego is the world’s most used all-in-one intelligence platform for complex cyber investigations.
company.description:
Maltego is the world’s most used all-in-one investigation platform that turns complex data into actionable insights in minutes. Used by industry experts, law enforcement, and analysts at major organizations, it brings together all your data in one place, helping you uncover hidden connections with a suite of investigative tools. 

With Maltego, teams can conduct everything from preliminary OSINT investigations to in-depth link analysis of large datasets. The platform also makes it easy to spot threats in real time with social media monitoring and enables the capture of digital evidence before it is altered or removed.

Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Maltego has grown to over 100 employees and is trusted by 2,000+ government organizations and 4,000+ companies worldwide—including the FBI, INTERPOL, and leading tech and financial firms, including half of the Dow 30.
